raw_segments.text: Decious. Never fear that. If he be so resolved I can oarsway him, for he loves to hear that
unicorns may be betrayed with trees and bears with glasses, elephants with holes, lions
with toils and men with flatterers. But when I tell him he hates flatterers, he says he
does, being then most flattered. Let me work, for I can give his humor the true bent and
I will bring him to the capital.
